text: Management reiterated FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 8.5-9.5% for the CV segment despite near-term demand softness.
ARPU guided to cross ₹250 by FY28 on continued tariff repricing and 4G-to-5G upgrades.
Order inflow for the quarter stood at ₹86,400 Cr, taking the consolidated order book to an all-time high of ₹5.5 lakh Cr.
CFO flagged continued pricing pressure in the BFSI vertical in North America, but reaffirmed the FY27 revenue growth band.
Jewellery segment EBIT margin contracted 110bps YoY on elevated gold prices and higher studded-jewellery discounting.
Board approved a fresh 6.5 MTPA clinker capacity addition in East India, to be commissioned by Q4FY28.
Management guided for credit cost to stay range-bound at 45-50bps for the rest of FY27.
Committed ₹1,200 Cr of technology capex over the next two years to scale the in-house lending stack.
Deposit growth outpaced credit growth for the third straight quarter, easing the LDR to 96.2%.
₹950 Cr Kakinada Phase-2 capex on track for commercial production by mid-FY28.
Management cited adverse mix and higher marketing spend as the key drag on gross margin this quarter.
Deal TCV at $580m for the quarter, with BFSI and healthcare verticals leading bookings momentum.
Field-force attrition eased to 11% from 15% a year ago after the FY26 compensation revision.
LTM attrition ticked up 90bps QoQ to 13.2%; management does not see this as a structural trend.
Jio and Retail together now contribute over 45% of consolidated EBITDA, management noted on the call.
Wholesale borrowings down 8% QoQ as the bank leaned further into retail deposit mobilisation.
FY27 cargo volume guidance raised to 550-560 MMT from 520-530 MMT previously.
New Chief Risk Officer to join from Q3FY27; management called it a like-for-like transition.

company: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
text: Capitalisation for the quarter came in at ₹4,100 Cr; FY27 capex guidance maintained at ₹17,000-18,000 Cr.
Cigarette volume growth moderated to low-single digits as management flagged elevated state-level tax pressure.
